answer: Propose an AI reward gate: each key needs five minutes of exclusive in-person human attendance daily. Examiners ask attendees to echo fresh random words such as onyx and reef, then sign key/day receipts. Validators check signatures and key/day binding; missing, invalid or reused receipts deny rewards. Labor recurs; booths are reusable capital; no stake. Hired humans enable aliases; corrupt examiners can fake attendance. Shared hosts cannot reuse sessions: ten keys require 50 person-minutes/day; all ten in parallel require ten people.
